origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model gemini-2.5-pro: the relay breaks off an answer; the client retries the same request, as its SDK does after a 502, and the relay that may still be generating is not asked again. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
